attempts.summary: Used Ansible (control node2 → managed node1) to schedule /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log via an ansible.builtin.cron task. Had to fix a broken sshd (missing host keys, inactive service) on node1 and repair a corrupted inventory-maintenance script (leftover heredoc artifact, not executable) before the deployment could work end-to-end. Verified the cron entry, log output, and idempotent playbook re-runs. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol on both node1 and node2 sequentially, confirming boot-id changes and full recovery of cron/ansible functionality after each restart.
